title.en: S&P 500 Falls Below 200-Day Average as AI Trade Wobble Meets Holiday Season
title.zh: 标普500跌破200日均线，AI交易波动遇上假日消费季

impact.en: The S&P 500 closed Thursday at 7,177.56, down 1.98%, marking a sixth straight losing session and a drop below the 200-day moving average for the first time since April. The index is down roughly 8% from its October 6 all-time high, with the technology sector slumping nearly 19% over the same period. Anthropic's IPO closed up 17% on its first day while major indexes sank, and Nvidia's solid quarterly report failed to steady the market. Premarket E-mini S&P 500 futures stand at 7,133.25, down 0.85% versus the prior cash close, suggesting a modest narrowing of losses. Oxford Economics projects holiday retail sales up 4.2% (2.2% in volume after inflation adjustment), and October core retail sales rose faster than expected. The S&P 500 remains on track for a year-to-date gain of nearly 5%. Next week brings Black Friday, Dell and Analog Devices earnings, inflation data, and a Q3 GDP update in a shortened Thanksgiving week.
impact.zh: 标普500周四收于7,177.56，下跌1.98%，连续第六个交易日收跌，并自4月以来首次跌破200日均线。该指数较10月6日历史高点回落约8%，科技板块同期跌幅近19%。Anthropic IPO首日收涨17%，但主要股指下跌；英伟达（NVDA）季度业绩稳健却未能稳定市场。盘前E-mini标普500期货报7,133.25，较前一交易日现金收盘下跌0.85%，显示跌幅有所收窄。牛津经济研究院预计假日零售销售增长4.2%（剔除通胀后实际量增2.2%），10月核心零售销售增速超预期。标普500年初至今仍录得近5%的涨幅。下周将迎来黑色星期五、戴尔（DELL）和模拟器件（ADI）财报、通胀数据及三季度GDP更新，交易周因感恩节缩短。

bullish: Oxford Economics projects holiday retail sales up 4.2% and October core retail sales rose faster than expected, supporting the consumer-spending pillar that drives roughly two-thirds of US GDP. / 牛津经济研究院预计假日零售销售增长4.2%，10月核心零售销售增速超预期，支撑占美国GDP约三分之二的消费支出支柱。
bearish: The S&P 500 is down roughly 8% from its October 6 all-time high and the technology sector has slumped nearly 19% over the same period, with doubts emerging about massive AI data-center spending that underpinned the four-year bull market. / 标普500较10月6日历史高点回落约8%，科技板块同期跌幅近19%，市场对支撑四年牛市的大规模AI数据中心支出产生质疑。

macroRisk.en: If holiday retail data or next week's inflation print disappoints, the consumer-driven recovery narrative weakens and the AI-trade wobble could extend beyond the technology sector into broader earnings expectations.
macroRisk.zh: 若假日零售数据或下周通胀数据不及预期，消费驱动的经济复苏叙事将减弱，AI交易波动可能从科技板块蔓延至更广泛的盈利预期。

title.en: Dollar Falls Early Friday Ahead of Waller Remarks and Michigan Sentiment
title.zh: 美元周五早盘下跌，等待沃勒讲话与密歇根消费者信心数据

impact.en: The US dollar fell against most major trading partners early Friday, with the US Dollar Index at 103.67, down 0.21% versus the prior cash-session reference. EUR/USD eased to 1.0963 from 1.0972, while USD/JPY slipped to 158.8771 from 159.6792. Fed Governor Christopher Waller spoke at 8:25 am ET, following his Wednesday call for "aggressive action" on interest rates that would "shock" businesses and markets. The final University of Michigan consumer sentiment reading for November and state-level October unemployment data are both due at 10:00 am ET, after the 09:00 EST information cutoff. The Kansas City Fed services index for November is scheduled at 11:00 am ET, the St. Louis Fed is expected to update its Q4 GDP nowcast around midday, and Fed Governor Lisa Cook is set to speak at 12:15 pm ET. US inflation has remained above the Fed's 2% target for nearly six years, and markets widely expect a 25 bp FOMC rate hike next month per the CME FedWatch tool.
impact.zh: 美元周五早盘对多数主要货币走弱，美元指数报103.67，较前一交易日现金收盘参考值下跌0.21%。欧元/美元从1.0972降至1.0963，美元/日元从159.6792降至158.8771。美联储理事克里斯托弗·沃勒于美东时间8:25发表讲话，此前他周三呼吁对利率采取将"震撼"企业和市场的"果断行动"。11月密歇根大学消费者信心终值及10月各州失业数据均定于美东时间10:00发布，晚于09:00 EST信息截止时点。堪萨斯城联储11月服务业指数定于11:00发布，圣路易斯联储预计于午间前后更新四季度GDP预测，美联储理事莉萨·库克定于12:15发表讲话。美国通胀已持续近六年高于美联储2%目标，市场普遍预期下月FOMC将加息25个基点（据CME FedWatch工具）。

bearish: Fed Governor Waller called on Wednesday for "aggressive action" on interest rates, and US inflation has remained above the 2% target for nearly six years, with markets widely expecting a 25 bp FOMC hike next month. / 美联储理事沃勒周三呼吁对利率采取"果断行动"，美国通胀已持续近六年高于2%目标，市场普遍预期下月FOMC将加息25个基点。

macroRisk.en: A hawkish Waller remark or a weaker-than-expected Michigan sentiment reading at 10:00 am ET could extend the risk-off move in equities and push the 10-year yield higher, complicating the already fragile AI-trade recovery.
macroRisk.zh: 若沃勒发表偏鹰言论或10:00美东时间密歇根消费者信心数据弱于预期，可能加剧股市风险偏好收缩并推高10年期收益率，使本已脆弱的AI交易修复更加复杂。

note.en: The premarket shows a modest narrowing from Thursday's broad selloff: E-mini S&P 500 futures are down 0.85% versus the prior cash close, compared with the 1.98% cash decline, while the 10-year yield has eased 8.4 basis points to 4.968% and the dollar index is slightly lower at 103.67. Softer yields and a weaker dollar would normally support risk assets. The strongest conflicting signal is COMEX gold, down 2.72% to $3,561.90 despite that backdrop, suggesting prior-session stress still drives positioning rather than a clean macro repricing. The stabilization thesis is therefore qualified. If the 09:30 ET cash open shows breadth broadening beyond large-cap tech while the 10-year holds near 4.97%, the view gains support. 若现货开盘后涨势扩散至大型科技股以外且10年期收益率维持在4.97%附近，将支持企稳判断。
note.zh: 盘前显示周四全面抛售的跌幅有所收窄：E-mini标普500期货较前一交易日现金收盘下跌0.85%，而现金指数跌幅为1.98%；10年期美债收益率回落8.4个基点至4.968%，美元指数微降至103.67。收益率走软和美元走弱通常利好风险资产。最强矛盾信号是COMEX黄金期货下跌2.72%至3,561.90美元，与上述背景相悖，表明前一日压力仍在主导仓位调整而非清晰的宏观重新定价。因此企稳判断需加限定。若美东时间09:30现货开盘后涨势扩散至大型科技股以外且10年期收益率维持在4.97%附近，将支持企稳判断。
